It's interesting. The article doesn't say whether or not there was an actual jury trial, only sentencing errata. It does, however, indicate that the charged was in Federal Court. The Federal system, I can attest unfortunately, has a sentencing methodology based upon newer Congressional standards surrounding the sentencing. The prosecutor can offer reduced sentences that the the judge can accept and sentence the charged with. If, on the other hand, the charged wants a jury trial and is found guilty, sentencing minimums must be enforced as imposed by Congress. This puts people charged under great duress. The story goes, "would you like to do the possible 80 years for what you are charged with or just accept the 8 years under a plea deal?"...................I'll take eight <gulp>
